text:
alex: kicking off staged rollout to 10% for inference-service v2.3.1 (embedding model variant). change window ends 03:30 UTC. deploy-bot started the rollout.

deploy-bot: [deploy] rollout id=r12345 status=started targets=10% region=global

maria: seeing a bump in embedding drift signal on search-recall AUC on eu-west logs, +4.2% degradation. loading more context.

ben: can you paste the eval diff? also which prompt set?

maria: quick snippet: ```eval: search_recall_auc: baseline=0.872 new=0.836 delta=-0.036``` looks concentrated on long-tail queries >128 tokens

sre-oncall: tagging infra — are there memory pressure or kv-cache issues? I see a few OOMs in canaries earlier.

julie: product concern: EU customers SLA window is tight, if this persists we should pin back to v2.2.9 for EU and continue global 10% elsewhere? 

alex: can we pause the rollout globally? deploy-bot, pause?

deploy-bot: [deploy] rollout id=r12345 status=paused by alex at 1887654400

alex: ok paused. proposal: pin eu-west traffic to v2.2.9 and resume other regions at 10% after additional evals. anyone object?

ben: +1 to pin EU. I'll prepare rollback pin config: ```routes:
  - region: eu-west
    pinned_version: v2.2.9
  - region: ap-south
    percent: 10
``` will open a PR

maria: running targeted eval on the new model with extended prompt set now; will have results in ~15m

sre-oncall: if we pin EU, watchfor tail latency, I'm putting a temporary alert on the v2.2.9 pool to catch any anomalies

alex: thanks. julie please update release notes / customer comms if we keep EU on older version. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/deploy/PR-428

julie: will do. draft comms ready, will hold until we confirm evaluation. :eyes:

maria: eval: long-tail AUC drop is concentrated on queries with repeated dates and code snippets, likely tokenization edge. Plan: revert tokenization tweak in next patch.

alex: plan agreed — pin EU, resume others at 10% after autosmoke, open rollback playbook, target full rollback if delta >3.5% after 30m. recording decision.

deploy-bot: [deploy] rollout id=r12345 actions: paused, route-pin applied (eu-west->v2.2.9), notify=channels:eng-releases,product

ben: PR merged and config applied at 1887654620

alex: last check — anyone raising blockers? otherwise closing thread when EU pin looks stable.

sre-oncall: monitoring; will escalate if errors spike. :thumbsup:

maria: will post eval results in 10m.
